description: This file contains PHP classes that implement compilation logic for the {nocache} and {/nocache} tags in the Smarty templating engine. It defines classes for handling the start and end of nocache blocks during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Nocache
classes.description: Handles compilation of {nocache} tags to enable nocache mode during template processing.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Nocacheclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of {/nocache} tags to disable nocache mode during template processing.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Sets the compiler into nocache mode when encountering {nocache} and exits that mode at {/nocache}.
